Nina and I intersect through her work on AdvertiseNow’s ad targeting systems. As a skip-level, I’ve observed her contributions via cross-team syncs and shared metrics—she’s a steady presence in our engineering workflows.  

Nina’s daily work balances deep technical execution with pragmatic problem-solving. She regularly optimizes cloud costs by refining Kubernetes cluster configurations, ensuring our ML pipelines run efficiently. Her REST APIs for data ingestion are reliable, and she’s mastered Docker for reproducible model training. These tools are second nature to her, shaping how our team iterates quickly.  

What stands out is her ownership of LLM-driven ad personalization. She architected a prompt engineering framework that boosted click-through rates by 18% in Q3, without sacrificing latency. Her MLOps practices—using MLflow and W&B—streamlined model deployment, reducing production rollout time by 30%. She also led a refactor of our NLP pipelines, integrating PyTorch and TensorFlow to scale recommendation systems across 50+ campaigns. Her code is clean, well-documented, and often serves as a reference for newer engineers.  

Nina’s strength lies in her ability to balance innovation with operational rigor. She’s unflinching in debugging complex systems and equally collaborative in mentoring peers. Her work ethic is disciplined—she prioritizes reliability over speed, which is critical in our high-stakes adtech environment. I’d welcome the chance to collaborate again.
